Would you like that one, with the refund going to your PayPal (your payment method on file)?

Also, please note: item modifications can only be done once per order, and after that the order can no longer be modified or cancelled. So please confirm this is the only item you want changed in this order.

Once I have your confirmation on both, I'll process the address change first and then the item modification.
